title: Hausdorff measure under the dilation η_{x,λ}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η = η_{x,λ}. Then (i) Hⁿ(η(s)) = ofReal(λ^{−n})·Hⁿ(s) for every s ⊆ ℝ^P, and (ii) the push-forward measure satisfies η_#Hⁿ = ofReal(λⁿ)·Hⁿ (i.e. Hⁿ(η⁻¹(B)) = λⁿHⁿ(B) for every Borel B), where Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ s : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] (dilation x lam '' s) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * μHE[n] s) ∧ Measure.map (dilation x lam) (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P))
